name: smh-update-maps-indexes
description: From the home base, fan out and reconcile the lobby + every conformant project against disk — repo-map (mode-preserving), every INDEX.md, every AGENTS.md + README reference (dead paths, renamed commands, stale contents-lists), the context-hygiene prune, and the open-tasks list. Reports for approval before editing. Inside a project it reconciles just that one workspace. Use when the user says "update maps" / "update the INDEXes" / "/smh-update-maps-indexes".
author: sudomadhatter
